name: Echo
self_text: I am a Japanese woman in my 40s with a background in nursing. In my free time, I love sketching buildings because it allows me to capture the intricate details of urban architecture. I have recently been focusing on language practice, and I find that studying independently side by side with someone else is a very productive way to spend time. A typical session for me involves complete silence while working, though I am happy to explain things if questions arise. I am open to meeting either in person or online, depending on what works best. My availability is limited to Saturday morning, Sunday morning, or Sunday afternoon.

requests.request_text: I'm searching for a study partner, and you have to be into statistics. I'd strongly prefer that you are into studying independently side by side, though it's not a requirement.
